Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a rare disease that can be caused by pathogenic variants, most frequently in the bone Morphogenetic Protein Receptor Type 2 ( BMPR2 ) gene. We formed a ClinGen variant curation expert panel to devise guidelines for the clinical interpretation of BMPR2 variants identified in PAH patients.
